reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a bordered card or screen containing an exclamation mark alongside lines of text, strongly conveying an error log, warning notice, alert banner, or urgent bulletin. It fits tasks centered on reviewing logs, handling official notices, or designing alert UI, though care must be taken not to misuse it as a generic 'urgent' priority marker on unrelated tasks.
